ucs.title: [LLM] Onyx Sleet (Andariel) public-facing exploit → web-tier process spawning download LOLBins
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Andariel initial-access chain: a Java/IIS/Tomcat web worker process spawning cmd/PowerShell that then drops second-stage payloads via certutil, bitsadmin, curl or Invoke-WebRequest. This is the documented post-exploitation pattern after Andariel weaponises Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228), ManageEngine ServiceDesk (CVE-2022-47966), and MOVEit (CVE-2023-34362) to deliver TigerRAT, BlackRAT, NukeSped and DTrack.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.process_name) as child_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","jusched.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*-urlcache*","*bitsadmin*/transfer*","*Invoke-WebRequest*","*DownloadString*","*DownloadFile*","*-decode *","*FromBase64String*")) AND NOT (Processes.user IN ("*$","NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM") AND Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*echo*","*\\inetsrv\\appcmd*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","jusched.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","DownloadFile","FromBase64String","curl -o ","wget -O ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where not (FileName =~ "cmd.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("appcmd list","iisreset"))   // strip benign IIS admin
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBase in ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","jusched.exe")
| where ChildBase in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    or CommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","DownloadFile","FromBase64String","curl -o ","wget -O ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where not (ChildBase == "cmd.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("appcmd list","iisreset"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Andariel (Onyx Sleet) Web-Tier Process Spawning Download LOLBin
id: 7c1b2d4f-3e8a-4f1b-b8c2-9a5e6f7d8c11
status: experimental
description: Detects the Andariel/Onyx Sleet post-exploitation chain where a Java/IIS web-worker spawns cmd/PowerShell or a download LOLBin (certutil, bitsadmin, curl, wget) after exploitation of Log4Shell, ManageEngine ServiceDesk (CVE-2022-47966) or MOVEit (CVE-2023-34362).
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/18/multiple-north-korean-threat-actors-exploiting-the-teamcity-cve-2023-42793-vulnerability/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-187a
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_web:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat10.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  cmd_download:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
      - 'certutil -decode'
      - 'bitsadmin /transfer'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'curl -o '
      - 'wget -O '
  filter_iis_admin:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'appcmd list'
      - 'iisreset'
  condition: parent_web and (child_lolbin or cmd_download) and not filter_iis_admin
falsepositives:
  - Web-server administration scripts kicked off by SCCM / Ansible
  - Application-server self-updaters that legitimately call curl
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\tomcat*.exe OR *\\Tomcat*.exe OR *\\java.exe OR *\\Java.exe OR *\\javaw.exe OR *\\httpd.exe OR *\\nginx.exe) AND (@Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CertUtil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSAdmin.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\wget.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"certutil -urlcache"* OR *"certutil -decode"* OR *"bitsadmin /transfer"* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *FromBase64String*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|tomcat\d*|java|javaw|httpd|nginx|jusched)\.exe$/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|wget|mshta|regsvr32|rundll32)\.exe$/i OR regex("(certutil\s+-urlcache|certutil\s+-decode|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|DownloadFile|FromBase64String)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| NOT (ImageFileName=/\\cmd\.exe$/i AND regex("(appcmd\s+list|iisreset)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: Andariel/Onyx Sleet is the DPRK cluster most consistently observed pivoting from internet-exposed Java middleware (Log4Shell, ManageEngine SDP CVE-2022-47966, MOVEit CVE-2023-34362, TeamCity CVE-2023-42793) directly into hands-on-keyboard cmd.exe → certutil/bitsadmin loaders that stage TigerRAT, BlackRAT and DTrack. The parent set (w3wp/tomcat/java) plus the LOLBin set is the actor's canonical T11

ucs.title: [LLM] Andariel Maui ransomware staging — renamed ProcDump on LSASS followed by interactive maui.exe -p execution
ucs.description: Hunts the documented Andariel pre-Maui-ransomware playbook from CISA AA22-187A: operator-driven LSASS credential dump using ProcDump (frequently renamed) followed within the same logon session by interactive execution of maui.exe (or rebranded variant) with the actor-specific `-p`/`-f`/`-d` switch that selects target paths. Maui is currently attributed almost exclusively to Andariel, so this combination is a fingerprint of the actor staging encryption.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process IN ("*lsass*","*-ma *","*-mm *") AND Processes.process IN ("*-accepteula*","*procdump*","*dump64*","*dump32*")) OR Processes.process IN ("*maui.exe -p *","*maui.exe -f *","*maui.exe -d *","*maui64.exe -p *") OR (Processes.original_file_name="procdump" AND Processes.process_name!="procdump.exe" AND Processes.process_name!="procdump64.exe") ) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_tools by host user | where distinct_tools >= 2 OR like(cmdline,"%maui%") | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LsassDumps =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-ma ","-mm ") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
         or (ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "procdump" and FileName !in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "-accepteula" and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LogonId,
              DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, DumpImage = FileName, DumpSHA256 = SHA256;
let MauiExec =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)^maui(64)?\.exe$"
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bmaui(64)?\.exe\s+-(p|f|d)\s+"
    | project MauiTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LogonId,
              MauiCmd = ProcessCommandLine, MauiSHA256 = SHA256;
LsassDumps
| join kind=inner MauiExec on DeviceId, AccountName
| where MauiTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 24h)
| extend MinutesBetween = datetime_diff('minute', MauiTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, MauiTime, MinutesBetween, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DumpImage, DumpCmd, DumpSHA256, MauiCmd, MauiSHA256
| order by MauiTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LsassDumps =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where (CommandLine has_any ("-ma ","-mm ") and CommandLine has "lsass")
         or (CommandLine has "-accepteula" and CommandLine has "lsass")
         or (ChildBase startswith "dump" and CommandLine has "lsass")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectLogonId,
              DumpCmd = CommandLine, DumpImage = NewProcessName;
let MauiExec =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildBase matches regex @"^maui(64)?\.exe$"
         or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bmaui(64)?\.exe\s+-(p|f|d)\s+"
    | project MauiTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              MauiCmd = CommandLine, MauiImage = NewProcessName;
LsassDumps
| join kind=inner MauiExec on Computer, SubjectUserName
| where MauiTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 24h)
| extend MinutesBetween = datetime_diff('minute', MauiTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, MauiTime, MinutesBetween, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          DumpImage, DumpCmd, MauiImage, MauiCmd
| order by MauiTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 AND ((@CommandLine:(*lsass* AND (*"-ma "* OR *"-mm "* OR *-accepteula*))) OR @Image:(*\\maui.exe OR *\\Maui.exe OR *\\MAUI.EXE OR *\\maui64.exe OR *\\Maui64.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"maui.exe -p "* OR *"maui.exe -f "* OR *"maui.exe -d "* OR *"maui64.exe -p "*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (regex("lsass", field=CommandLine, flags="i") AND regex("(-ma\s|-mm\s|-accepteula)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")) OR ImageFileName=/\\maui(64)?\.exe$/i OR regex("\\bmaui(64)?\\.exe\\s+-(p|f|d)\\s+", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
| count >= 1
ucs.rationale: CISA/FBI AA22-187A and Stairwell's reverse-engineering of the Maui sample tie this ransomware family almost exclusively to Andariel/Onyx Sleet, distinguished by manual operator invocation with explicit path arguments (`-p`, `-f`, `-d`) rather than worm-style propagation. Andariel's pre-encryption tradecraft consistently chains a ProcDump variant against LSASS (often renamed dump64.exe / sqldumper.
